title: Feature, mechanic and system page standard

sections.what: Define and document the three-tier page standard every vault note follows: a **feature** page (what you do or use), its **mechanics** (how it works), and the **system** (where it lives - code, data, config). Replace the scaffolded stub format with a hand-written template.
sections.why: We settled the model (feature = what you do/use, mechanic = how it works, system = the implemented whole) but nothing encodes it. The generated Features/ stubs do not follow it, and a new page has no shape to copy. This is the keystone: the Commands collapse, the Environment family and the deep-doc re-home are all 'apply this template'.
sections.how: Amend AGENTS.md's 'Writing documentation (the Ways standard)' section to name the three tiers and the three readers (player / author / engineer). Add a page template (headings + what goes in each). Use `Ways.md` and `World Building/Movement.md` as the two worked exemplars.
sections.verify:
1. Open AGENTS.md and the template.
   - expected: the three tiers are named, with what belongs in each.
   - observed: TODO
2. Write a stub page from the template cold.
   - expected: no guessing about structure.
   - observed: TODO

acceptance.text: AGENTS.md states the feature / mechanic / system tiers and their readers
a page template exists with fixed headings
Ways.md and Movement.md are named as the exemplars
a new page can be written from the template without guessing
